messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: svc-inference-canary — 5/6 canary instances reporting 5xx for /v1/generate. Trigger=deploy-2026-03-14.

PagerDuty: Pager created: INCIDENT-canary-failure routed to on-call. Escalation policy: inference-team -> eng-runtime.

ryan.oncall: ACK — I'm on it. pinging logs, grabbing prometheus. anyone else seeing this?

alice.k: saw a tiny blip on staging earlier. could be KV cache pressure. pulling k8s events now.

bob.l: prometheus snapshots: p50 now 210ms -> 1.2s, p95 400ms -> 2.6s, error rate for canary pods 37% at 14:12 UTC.

carla.m: rolling canary is 6 pods across us-west-2. cmd: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference,canary=true -n prod -o wide`

ryan.oncall: attaching container logs from pod inference-canary-2 —
```
2026-03-14T14:11:58Z inference: ERROR runtime: KV cache miss, fallback to prefix recompute
2026-03-14T14:12:01Z model-serving: ERROR allocation failed: out of memory
2026-03-14T14:12:01Z kernel: OOMKilled process pid=1234 (model_server)
```

charlie.r: OOMKilled? runtime change in this release touched memory allocation and kernel selection. could be a regression.

eve.s: release diff: runtime v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0, introduced alternative attention kernels and changed default cache prefetch.

alice.k: immediate mitigation: shift traffic off canary and back to stable. who can update the rollout controller?

bob.l: use the rollout CLI: `redwood rollout set-split --service inference --canary 0 --stable 100 --reason "canary OOMs"` — will reconfigure traffic immediately.

ryan.oncall: executing split now. watching error rates.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: rollout split updated: canary=0 stable=100 (actor=ryan.oncall). Suppressing further pages from this alert group for 10m.

bob.l: error rate dropping to ~2% across the service within 90s. latency returning to baseline.

carla.m: recommend blocking v2.8.0 rollout and opening rollback PR. this looks like a memory regression triggered by the new kernel selection heuristics.

alice.k: +1. I'll open the rollback PR and coordinate an immediate region-by-region rollback if needed. tagging @eng-runtime for review.

ryan.oncall: customer impact summary: transient errors lasted ~3m while canary was at 10% traffic. estimated ~0.25% of global requests affected, no SLO breaches for enterprise customers reported yet.

charlie.r: starting follow-up doc and timeline. will capture logs, heap profiles, and kernel diffs.

eve.s: adding postmortem template and linking memory profiles. Suggest we add a canary memory-saturation gate to rollout checks.

alice.k: rollback PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/inference/rollbacks/PR-432 — includes revert of runtime bump and a hotfix to fallback to previous kernel on OOM.

ryan.oncall: handing off to @alice.k for PR merge and to @carla.m for rollout pause/monitor. I'll remain available for 15m then hand to next on-call. :thumbsup:

alice.k: merging PR after CI passes. will coordinate gradual rollout to avoid flapping.

IncidentBot: Notice: Pager suppression in effect; incident marked as "monitoring". Closing thread when rollback merged and postmortem created.

carla.m: quick note — created a short customer-facing blurb for CS in #customer-success: "We observed a brief canary regression during a staged runtime upgrade; traffic was shifted and a rollback initiated. No customer data impact."

ryan.oncall: ACK. closing voice channel in 10. leaving this thread open for final merge + postmortem link.
